item.title: This Video Does Not Show Iran’s Recent Attack On Dubai

item.title: Old Video From US Shared As Evacuation At Israeli Airport After Iran’s Attack

item.title: Israel-US Conflict With Iran: No, This Video Does Not Show Massive Explosions In Tel Aviv
item.description: An old video from China has been falsely shared to show massive explosions in Tel Aviv amid ongoing conflict.

item.title: Video Claiming To Show Iran Striking Israeli Nuclear Site Is From 2017 Blaze At Ukrainian Arms Depot
item.description: An old video from Ukraine has been falsely shared to show Iran striking Israeli nuclear site amid current conflict.

item.title: Unrelated Video Shared As Destruction In Abu Dhabi After Recent Iranian Airstrikes
item.description: An old video from Dubai is being falsely shared to show destruction in Abu Dhabi after recent airstrikes by Iran.

item.title: AI-Generated Footage Viral As Iran’s Airstrikes Near Dubai’s Burj Khalifa
item.description: The viral clip allegedly showing Iran bombarding areas near Burj Khalifa was found to be AI-generated.

item.title: Viral Video Showing Rajnath Singh Supporting Israel’s Attack On Iran Is Doctored
item.description: A manipulated video has been circulated online to falsely portray Rajnath Singh as supporting Israel’s attack on Iran.

item.title: Old Video Falsely Linked To Iran’s Drone Attack On US Embassy In Riyadh

item.title: Old Kerch Bridge Explosion Video Falsely Shared As Iranian Missile Attack On King Fahd Causeway
item.description: An old 2022 video showing an explosion at the Kerch Bridge in Crimea has been falsely linked to recent tensions in West Asia and shared as footage of an Iranian missile attack on the King Fahd Causeway.
